lessons.title: Problems about Pets
lessons.sourceTeacherGoal: Solve Put Together, Total Unknown story problems in a way that makes sense to them. Write an equation and explain why it matches a story problem.
lessons.originalStudentTask: Put together a pet total with no join/leave action; compare two equations for the same groups; further centers available.
priorBlockingFindings: The numeric total does not verify both student equations, reasoning about commutativity, or student drawings.
Source equation images are not visually reviewed; classroom center activities untested.
